name: CS Token
fix_description: The private sync() function directly reduces _tOwned[uniswapV2Pair] based on accumulated sellAmount and calls pair.sync(). The sellAmount global variable can be inflated by repeated sells before sync is triggered. Fix: add per-block rate limit on the burn amount, or cap the burnAmount per sync call to a small percentage of pair balance to prevent large single-tx drainage.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is more than a trivial bug because it uses a flash swap, repeated router interactions to manipulate protocol-specific token accounting, and a crafted sell loop exploiting the stale global `sellAmount` state. Although the PoC is short, an auditor would need to understand the token’s custom burn logic and why repeated buys/sells trigger the miscalculation, so it is not a simple one-call pattern.
